question: What's in P.F. Chang's Chicken Lettuce Wraps?
quick_answer: Chang's Chicken Lettuce Wraps are P.F. Chang's signature appetizer and have been on the menu since the first restaurant opened in 1993. Finely chopped chicken is wok-seared with mushrooms, water chestnuts and green onions in a savory sauce, served over crispy rice sticks with cool lettuce cups to wrap it in. They cost about $12 to $15 depending on location, and a full order is roughly 730 calories.
key_facts: P.F. Chang's best-known appetizer, on the menu since 1993
Wok-seared chicken with mushrooms, water chestnuts and green onions
Served over crispy rice sticks with lettuce cups
About $12 to $15; price varies by location
Roughly 730 calories for a full order; a vegetarian version is available

body.heading: What's in the lettuce wraps
body.text: The filling is finely chopped chicken stir-fried in a wok with mushrooms, crunchy water chestnuts and green onions, then tossed in a savory, slightly sweet sauce. It comes on a bed of crispy fried rice sticks, with a stack of cool, crisp lettuce leaves on the side. You spoon the filling into a lettuce cup, add sauce and eat it like a small taco. P.F. Chang's calls the recipe a secret, so it doesn't list every ingredient.

body.heading: How much they cost
body.text: Chang's Chicken Lettuce Wraps usually cost about $12 to $15 in the restaurant, and more on delivery apps. The vegetarian version is made with wok-seared tofu, green onion, mint and water chestnuts, and many locations also offer a gluten-free version of the chicken wraps. For the rest of P.F. Chang's prices, see our P.F. Chang's menu page.

body.heading: Calories and nutrition
body.text: Lettuce makes them sound light, but the sauce and fried rice sticks add up. P.F. Chang's nutrition information puts a full order of chicken lettuce wraps at about 730 calories, with a fair amount of sugar and sodium. Shared as a starter, it is much more reasonable. The vegetarian lettuce wraps are a bit lower, at about 640 calories.

body.heading: Why they're so popular
body.text: The lettuce wraps have been P.F. Chang's most famous dish since the first restaurant opened in 1993. They are easy to share, fun to build yourself and a mix of hot, crunchy and cool. They are also one of the most copied restaurant dishes online.

body.heading: How to make them at home
body.text: Copycat recipes usually brown ground chicken with garlic, onion and ginger, then add chopped water chestnuts and mushrooms and a sauce of hoisin, soy sauce and rice vinegar. Serve it in butter or iceberg lettuce cups. Frying a few rice sticks on top gets you closer to the restaurant version.

faqs.q: Does P.F. Chang's have vegetarian lettuce wraps?
faqs.a: Yes. The vegetarian lettuce wraps use wok-seared tofu with green onion, mint and water chestnuts.

_data_notes.fact_source: Signature dish, secret family recipe, ingredients not fully listed, 730 cal chicken / 640 cal vegetarian, high sugar/sodium: Livestrong (citing P.F. Chang's nutrition). Most popular appetizer since 1993 opening; ~$14.50 at one location: copycat-spices blog. Site's P.F. Chang's menu page: $11.50 chicken / $9.50 vegetarian, 'wok-seared chicken with cool lettuce cups'. Water chestnuts, mushrooms, maifun rice sticks: copycat recipes (Dinner then Dessert, Taste of Home). Copycat sauce (hoisin, soy, rice vinegar, ginger): Damn Delicious, The Cozy Cook. Official menu wording (wok-seared chicken, mushrooms, green onions, water chestnuts, crispy rice sticks, lettuce cups) and vegetarian version (tofu, green onion, mint, water chestnuts): P.F. Chang's menu copies on Foursquare, AllMenus, MenuWithPrice. Gluten-free version and delivery prices up to ~$19.49: AllMenus (Grubhub). Since 1993: Taste of Home. Checked Nov 14, 2026.
